        /// Called before spawn. The worker stamps this only after acquiring a
        /// semaphore permit: queued workers retain FIFO position, without a false
        /// execution timeout. Admission remains protected by `in_flight`.
        pub(super) fn reserve(&mut self, repo: &Path) -> Arc<OnceLock<Instant>> {
            let started = Arc::new(OnceLock::new());
            self.running.insert(repo.to_path_buf(), started.clone());
            started
        }
    
        pub(super) fn set_budget(&mut self, repo: &Path, budget: Duration) {
            self.budgets.insert(repo.to_path_buf(), budget);
        }
    
        pub(super) fn ready(&self, repo: &Path, now: Instant) -> bool {
            self.retry_after.get(repo).is_none_or(|until| now >= *until)
        }
    
        /// Returns each expired execution once. Keep both ownership and the
        /// permit until the actual worker joins; never kill by PID/name or unlink
        /// a Git lock. A non-yielding task cannot be safely force-replaced.
        pub(super) fn expired(&mut self, now: Instant, budget: Duration) -> Vec<PathBuf> {
            self.running
                .iter()
                .filter_map(|(repo, started)| {
                    let started = started.get()?;
                    let allowed = self.budgets.get(repo).copied().unwrap_or(budget);
                    if now.saturating_duration_since(*started) >= allowed
                        && self.cancelling.insert(repo.clone())
                    {
                        Some(repo.clone())
                    } else {
                        None
                    }
                })
                .collect()
        }
    
        /// Only a joined worker can finish. Errors (including panics/cancellation)
        /// yield capacity with capped backoff; success resets the failure streak.
        pub(super) fn finish(&mut self, repo: &Path, failed: bool, now: Instant) {
            self.budgets.remove(repo);
            self.running.remove(repo);
            self.cancelling.remove(repo);
            if failed {
                let count = self.failures.entry(repo.to_path_buf()).or_default();
                *count = count.saturating_add(1);
                self.retry_after.insert(
                    repo.to_path_buf(),
                    now + super::classification_backoff_secs(*count),
                );
            } else {
                self.failures.remove(repo);
                self.retry_after.remove(repo);
            }
        }
    }
    
    /// Oldest admitted probe first, with never-admitted repos ahead of repeat
    /// customers. Stable sorting preserves the existing deadline/result hints for
    /// equal admission stamps. This ordering applies across priority tiers so an
    /// always-dirty early repo cannot monopolize a bounded probe pool.
    pub(super) fn fair_probe_order(repos: &mut [PathBuf], admitted: &HashMap<PathBuf, Instant>) {
        repos.sort_by_key(|repo| admitted.get(repo).copied());
    }
    
    /// A total-operation backstop must not undercut the independently bounded
    /// push commands it supervises. Include one possible new commit, every target,
    /// configured retries and the process runner's progress hard limit. Local-only
    /// work retains the normal short backstop; arithmetic never wraps.
    pub(super) fn execution_budget(
        policy: &crate::policy::SyncPolicy,
        ahead: u64,
        has_origin: bool,
        commit_only: bool,
    ) -> Duration {
        let local = policy.repo_sync_timeout_secs.max(900);
        if !policy.auto_push || commit_only {
            return Duration::from_secs(local);
        }
        let targets = (policy.remotes.len() as u64).saturating_add(u64::from(has_origin));
        let idle =
            crate::sync::scale_push_timeout(policy.push_op_timeout_secs, ahead.saturating_add(1));
        let push = crate::git::progress_hard_timeout_secs(idle)
            .saturating_mul(u64::from(policy.push_retries.max(1)))
            .saturating_mul(targets);
        Duration::from_secs(local.saturating_add(push))
    }

    #[tokio::main(flavor = "multi_thread")]
    async fn main() -> Result<()> {
        // If output is piped (e.g. `dracon-sync repos | head`), stdout can become a broken pipe.
        // Rust's default printing panics on write errors; convert that specific panic into a clean exit.
        let default_panic_hook = std::panic::take_hook();
        std::panic::set_hook(Box::new(move |info| {
            let msg = info.to_string();
            if msg.contains("Broken pipe") {
                std::process::exit(0);
            }
            default_panic_hook(info);
        }));
    
        let cli = Cli::parse();
        #[cfg(unix)]
        if matches!(&cli.cmd, Command::Once | Command::SyncNow { .. }) {
            use tokio::signal::unix::{signal, SignalKind};
            let mut terminate = signal(SignalKind::terminate())?;
            let mut interrupt = signal(SignalKind::interrupt())?;
            return until_sync_cancelled(Box::pin(run_cli(cli)), async move {
                tokio::select! {
                    _ = terminate.recv() => {},
                    _ = interrupt.recv() => {},
                }
            })
            .await;
        }
        run_cli(cli).await
    }
    
    /// Drop owned Git work and leases before reporting an interrupted one-shot
    /// sync. Daemon and maintenance retain their own shutdown/resume handlers.
    #[cfg(unix)]
    async fn until_sync_cancelled<T>(
        work: impl std::future::Future<Output = Result<T>>,
        cancel: impl std::future::Future<Output = ()>,
    ) -> Result<T> {
        tokio::select! {
            result = work => result,
            _ = cancel => Err(anyhow::anyhow!("sync interrupted; owned operations cancelled")),
        }
    }

    /// other scheme) userinfo leaked in git error echoes — and the push

    /// all-scheme `ownership::redact_url_credentials` the ledger writes
    /// use. One redactor now: delegate. Output shape changes from
    /// `https://***@host/` to `https://host/` (the git/mod.rs shape test
    /// was updated to the unified contract in the same change).
    pub(crate) fn redact_credentials_for_log(msg: &str) -> String {
        crate::ownership::redact_url_credentials(msg)
    }
    
    /// Truncate retained error detail so per-forge context stays ledger-sized.
    pub(crate) fn clip_error_detail(msg: &str) -> String {
        const LIMIT: usize = 500;
        let flat: String = msg.split_whitespace().collect::<Vec<_>>().join(" ");
        if flat.len() <= LIMIT {
            return flat;
        }
        // Cut on a char boundary, never mid-codepoint.
        let mut end = LIMIT;
        while !flat.is_char_boundary(end) {
            end -= 1;
        }
        format!("{}…", &flat[..end])
    }

    /// of the skip, so the operator checks secrets instead of transport.

        format!("{forge}: no token configured (skipped)")
    }

    /// the `index.lock` check covers the checkout phase.
    pub(crate) fn is_stable_empty_repo(repo: &Path) -> bool {
        let dot_git = repo.join(".git");
        if !dot_git.is_dir() {
            return false;
        }
        let head = match std::fs::read_to_string(dot_git.join("HEAD")) {
            Ok(h) => h,
            Err(_) => return false,
        };
        if !head.trim_start().starts_with("ref: refs/") {
            return false;
        }
        if let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(&dot_git) {
            for entry in entries.flatten() {
                if entry.file_name().to_string_lossy().ends_with(".lock") {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }
        let pack_dir = dot_git.join("objects").join("pack");
        if let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(&pack_dir) {
            for entry in entries.flatten() {
                if entry.file_name().to_string_lossy().starts_with("tmp_pack_") {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }
        true
    }
    
    /// ADDED 2026-07-21 (v0.112.30): whether the current branch has an
    /// upstream configured (`branch.<name>.remote` + `branch.<name>.merge`)
    /// but the corresponding remote-tracking ref
    /// (`refs/remotes/<remote>/<branch>`) does NOT exist. This is the
    /// "never pushed" (or "remote branch deleted") state: libgit2's
    /// ahead/behind computation returns 0 because there is nothing to
    /// compare against, which previously hid the fact that EVERY commit on
    /// HEAD was unpushed — the daemon's `has_local_or_pending_work` check
    /// then treated the repo as fully synced and skipped it forever.
    pub(crate) fn upstream_tracking_ref_missing(repo: &Path) -> bool {
        let Some(branch) = current_branch(repo) else {
            return false;
        };
        let output = crate::policy::std_git_command()
            .args(["config", "--get", &format!("branch.{}.remote", branch)])
            .current_dir(repo)
            .output();
        let remote = match output {
            Ok(o) if o.status.success() => {
                let r = String::from_utf8_lossy(&o.stdout).trim().to_string();
                if r.is_empty() {
                    return false;
                }
                r
            }
            _ => return false,
        };
        // Sanitize: remote names come from git config; refuse anything that
        // could escape the refs/remotes/ namespace.
        if remote.contains("..") || remote.contains('/') || remote.starts_with('.') {
            return false;
        }
        let tracking_ref = format!("refs/remotes/{}/{}", remote, branch);
        crate::policy::std_git_command()
            .args(["rev-parse", "--verify", "-q", &tracking_ref])
            .current_dir(repo)
            .stdout(std::process::Stdio::null())
            .stderr(std::process::Stdio::null())
            .status()
            .map(|s| !s.success())
            .unwrap_or(false)
    }

    ///
    /// Returns Ok(true) when a root commit was created, Ok(false) when

    pub(crate) async fn bootstrap_empty_repo_commit(
        repo: &Path,
        policy: &SyncPolicy,
        excluded_dir_names: &BTreeSet<String>,

    ) -> Result<bool> {
        if !policy.auto_commit {
            return Ok(false);

        fn init_empty_repo(path: &std::path::Path) {
            std::fs::create_dir_all(path).unwrap();
            let status = crate::git::git_cmd()
                .args(["init", "-q", "-b", "main"])
                .arg(path)
                .status()
                .unwrap();
            assert!(status.success());
            for (k, v) in [("user.email", "test@test"), ("user.name", "test")] {
                let status = crate::git::git_cmd()
                    .args(["config", k, v])
                    .current_dir(path)
                    .status()
                    .unwrap();
                assert!(status.success());
            }
        }
    
        fn head_commit_count(path: &std::path::Path) -> u64 {
            let output = crate::git::git_cmd()
                .args(["rev-list", "--count", "HEAD"])
                .current_dir(path)
                .output()
                .unwrap();
            if !output.status.success() {
                return 0;
            }
            String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout)
                .trim()
                .parse()
                .unwrap_or(0)
        }
